Two-group differential expression on a gene panel in one TCGA or other GDC cohort, as GeneFox's...

gf_tcga_differential_expression.Rd

Two-group differential expression on a gene panel in one TCGA or other GDC cohort, as GeneFox's Differential screen computes it: per-gene two-sided Mann-Whitney on one mean per patient, Benjamini-Hochberg over the WHOLE requested panel (unresolved or underpowered genes kept at p = 1), the volcano, the ranked table and the CSV. Four contrasts (each offered where the data allows): tumor_vs_normal (baseline tumors vs GTEx donors of the matched tissue, TOIL hub), expression_high_low (median split of split_gene), subgroup (two levels of a clinical factor or molecular subtype), mutation_status (split_gene Mutant vs WT). Panel: genes (2-80), a bundled preset, or the screen's default panel. csv, recipe, html. Latency: 10-60 s cold. The figure is the app screen's PNG export.

Usage

gf_tcga_differential_expression(
    session,
    `project`,
    `arm_order` = NULL,
    `csv` = NULL,
    `dpi` = NULL,
    `factor` = NULL,
    `figure` = NULL,
    `format` = NULL,
    `genes` = NULL,
    `group1` = NULL,
    `group2` = NULL,
    `gtex_tissue` = NULL,
    `height_in` = NULL,
    `html` = NULL,
    `inline_image` = NULL,
    `log2fc_cutoff` = NULL,
    `mode` = NULL,
    `outline_text` = NULL,
    `output_name` = NULL,
    `preset` = NULL,
    `q_cutoff` = NULL,
    `recipe` = NULL,
    `show_caption_color_keys` = NULL,
    `show_figure_legends` = NULL,
    `show_row_counts` = NULL,
    `size` = NULL,
    `sort` = NULL,
    `split_gene` = NULL,
    `survival_detail` = NULL,
    `survival_median_lines` = NULL,
    `width_in` = NULL,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

project

(string; one of "TCGA-ACC", "TCGA-BLCA", "TCGA-BRCA", "TCGA-CESC", "TCGA-CHOL", "TCGA-COAD", "TCGA-DLBC", "TCGA-ESCA", "TCGA-GBM", "TCGA-HNSC", "TCGA-KICH", "TCGA-KIRC", "TCGA-KIRP", "TCGA-LAML", "TCGA-LGG", "TCGA-LIHC", "TCGA-LUAD", "TCGA-LUSC", "TCGA-MESO", "TCGA-OV", "TCGA-PAAD", "TCGA-PCPG", "TCGA-PRAD", "TCGA-READ", "TCGA-SARC", "TCGA-SKCM", "TCGA-STAD", "TCGA-TGCT", "TCGA-THCA", "TCGA-THYM", "TCGA-UCEC", "TCGA-UCS", "TCGA-UVM", "TARGET-ALL-P1", "TARGET-ALL-P2", "TARGET-ALL-P3", "TARGET-AML", "TARGET-CCSK", "TARGET-NBL", "TARGET-OS", "TARGET-RT", "TARGET-WT", "APOLLO-LUAD", "BEATAML1.0-COHORT", "CDDP_EAGLE-1", "CGCI-BLGSP", "CGCI-HTMCP-CC", "CGCI-HTMCP-DLBCL", "CGCI-HTMCP-LC", "CMI-ASC", "CMI-MBC", "CMI-MPC", "CPTAC-2", "CPTAC-3", "CTSP-DLBCL1", "EXCEPTIONAL_RESPONDERS-ER", "HCMI-CMDC", "MMRF-COMMPASS", "MP2PRT-ALL", "MP2PRT-WT", "NCICCR-DLBCL", "OHSU-CNL", "ORGANOID-PANCREATIC", "REBC-THYR", "WCDT-MCRPC") TCGA/TARGET/other GDC project id with a GDC Xena expression dataset, e.g. TCGA-BRCA.

arm_order

(string, optional; one of "high_first", "low_first", "mutant_first", "wt_first") expression_high_low: high_first (default) or low_first; mutation_status: mutant_first (default) or wt_first. The second order inverts fold changes. NULL omits it.

csv

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write the screen's CSV export (the app's own rows) under the output directory and return csv.path. NULL omits it.

dpi

(integer, optional; default 300; range 72..1200) Resolution of a custom size (at most 8,192 px a side and 16 MP). NULL omits it.

factor

(string, optional; one of "subtype", "sex_at_birth", "vital_status", "stage", "race", "ethnicity", "age_group", "diagnosis", "disease_type", "grade") subgroup: factor whose two levels are compared. Default Stage, or the first comparable factor in the cohort. NULL omits it.

figure

(boolean, optional; default true) Draw the figure and return its PNG path. NULL omits it.

format

(string, optional; one of "png", "svg", "tiff"; default "png") Figure format: png (raster, default), svg (vector with editable text), or tiff (raster, .tif); one per run. NULL omits it.

genes

(array, optional) 2 to 80 distinct gene symbols, canonicalized via the human symbol/alias reference and de-duplicated; tokens and dataset mappings remain inspectable. At most one of genes and preset; neither uses the default panel. NULL omits it.

group1

(string, optional) subgroup: first testable level (Group 1; see data.levels). With group2, or neither: first two testable levels. Unicode allowed; control and format characters refused. NULL omits it.

group2

(string, optional) subgroup: second level (Group 2); swapping groups inverts fold changes. Unicode allowed; control and format characters refused. NULL omits it.

gtex_tissue

(string, optional) tumor_vs_normal: one mapped GTEx tissue, required if several map. Donor means use only this tissue, not pooled tissues. NULL omits it.

height_in

(number, optional; range 1..40) Custom figure height in inches (with the other side; instead of size). The app's size control range. NULL omits it.

html

(boolean, optional; default false) Write the screen's single-figure HTML export under the output directory and return html.path. Requires figure. NULL omits it.

inline_image

(boolean, optional; default false) Include PNG MCP image content up to 1,048,576 bytes; larger files stay on disk and disclose inline_image_omitted. NULL omits it.

log2fc_cutoff

(number, optional; default 1; range 0..3) The |Δ mean log₂ expression| shading threshold (0 to 3); it does not enter the test. NULL omits it.

mode

(string, optional; one of "tumor_vs_normal", "expression_high_low", "subgroup", "mutation_status") Contrast; default tumor_vs_normal where offered for the cohort, otherwise subgroup. NULL omits it.

outline_text

(boolean, optional; default false) With format svg, write labels as glyph outlines instead of editable text. Refused with other formats. NULL omits it.

output_name

(string, optional) Optional figure name replacing tool and title slug: up to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'; starts alphanumeric, no '..'. Session number, size and extension remain; collisions get -2, -3, etc. NULL omits it.

preset

(string, optional) The name of one of the app's bundled gene-set presets (the panel's Load preset… menu), exactly as listed. NULL omits it.

q_cutoff

(number, optional; default 0.05; range 0.0001..1) The BH q threshold (the screen's FDR slider range, 0.0001 to 1). It never enters the test. NULL omits it.

recipe

(boolean, optional; default false) Write an app recipe that reopens this analysis and return recipe.path. NULL omits it.

show_caption_color_keys

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: a table caption carries the sentence explaining the figure's colors. NULL omits it.

show_figure_legends

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: the figure draws its own legend. NULL omits it.

show_row_counts

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: a box plot's row labels carry each group's n. NULL omits it.

size

(string, optional; one of "single_column", "one_and_a_half_column", "double_column", "slide", "poster"; default "double_column") Figure size preset (the app's export presets); double_column is the app default. NULL omits it.

sort

(string, optional; one of "q", "effect"; default "q") On-screen table order: q (p then symbol) or effect (|Δ| descending). CSV and report tables retain kernel order. NULL omits it.

split_gene

(string, optional) expression_high_low: gene for patient-level median split; mutation_status: gene for non-silent Mutant vs WT split. NULL omits it.

survival_detail

(string, optional; one of "none", "inference", "inferenceAndEffect", "full"; default "inferenceAndEffect") Figure style: how much of a Kaplan-Meier findings block to draw (the app's Figure Style setting). NULL omits it.

survival_median_lines

(boolean, optional; default false) Figure style: draw dashed median survival guides for reached medians. NULL omits it.

width_in

(number, optional; range 1..40) Custom figure width in inches (with the other side; instead of size). The app's size control range. NULL omits it.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the tcga_differential_expression tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/tcga-differential-expression-result-v1.schema.json.
